description: This file defines the final class ScenarioSetup which encapsulates various properties related to testing scenarios in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes constructors, getter methods, and a detailed toString implementation, handling permissions, authorization context, resource pointers, expected outcomes, and related JSON views.

classes.name: ScenarioSetup
classes.description: A final class representing configuration for a test scenario, including permission policies, context, resources, expected results, and optional JSON views and algorithms.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Returns the policy associated with this scenario.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context for this scenario.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the resource pointer for this scenario.

methods.name: getRequiredPermissions
methods.description: Returns the required permissions for access.

methods.name: getExpectedResult
methods.description: Returns whether the expected outcome of the scenario is success (true) or failure (false).

methods.name: getFullJsonifiable
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the full JSON representation associated with the scenario.

methods.name: getExpectedSubjectIds
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the set of expected subject IDs.

methods.name: getExpectedJsonView
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the expected JSON view.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the scenario.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type/category of the scenario.

methods.name: getAdditionalAlgorithmFunction
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing an additional algorithm function for custom policy evaluation.
